inputs.declared_question: Does the existing OCI Image Specification relation still offer a cautious technical precedent for carrying a generative plate's dependencies and execution assumptions without suggesting that a container image is the press or its edition authority?

external_region.title: Open Container Initiative Image Format Specification

sources_checked.title: Field Note 33: The Plate and the Pull

source_facts.claim: Version 1.1.1 defines OCI images through a manifest, optional index, filesystem layers, and configuration for interoperable build, transport, and preparation to run.
Image configuration separates ordered filesystem changes from execution settings including entrypoint, default arguments, environment, and volumes.
A content descriptor identifies referenced bytes by media type, digest, and raw size, and the specification directs consumers to verify retrieved content.
The image layout uses an index and content-addressed blobs, but permits missing referenced blobs to be fulfilled by an external blob store.
Field Note 33 asks how a public generative algorithm, recognized lineage of pulls, and browser encounter can survive the disappearance of the original venue.

cartographer.inference: The existing possible technical adjacency remains bounded. OCI demonstrates an explicit distinction among executable content, runtime configuration, platform alternatives, and verifiable references. FN-33 proposes a different object and authority: a browser-readable generative plate with Bitcoin pull lineage and a verifiable ending. OCI's allowance for externally supplied blobs remains an important portability limit.
cartographer.uncertainty: The versioned documents support a packaging analogy, not a claim that OCI alone ensures future runtime compatibility, availability of missing blobs, authentic artistic lineage, or a sufficient browser renderer.
cartographer.attribution: External facts come only from the OCI's official specification index and versioned public repository. No external person or organization was contacted, and no private material was read.
cartographer.no_proposal_reason: The official versioned sources remain accessible and consistent with the existing node and technical-adjacency proposal. No new candidate or amendment would materially improve the map.

Retain the possible, emerging technical adjacency, including the difference between a container runtime image and an authorized generative-art edition.
Leave the existing three-item Attending arrangement unchanged. A routine source recheck does not create a material relational turn.
